notes: The with of with a bond is placed on ʾissār under rule 33 rather than on ʿal, which the ASV leaves unstated once his soul becomes a bare object (rule 40).
The casuistic kî takes the ASV's When under rule 55; ʾîš keeps a man, its indefinite article belonging to the noun under rule 15.
kol and lōʾ each hold a written English word here (all, not), so no rule 35 fusion arises and rule 2 keeps them apart.
